name: docparse_spec_select
description: Rank caller-provided docparse spec candidates for a host-approved local document. Host projects own private spec registries and document roots.

user_message.description: Original user request or short task note used only for ranking context.

document_path.description: Workspace-local or host-approved document artifact reference to inspect.

spec_path.description: Single candidate spec path when the caller wants to rank or validate one spec.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of leading pages to inspect for spec ranking.

artifact_policy.description: Host artifact policy hint such as summary, full, or none.
